purpose: Independent falsifiable successor to frozen MD30 negative: test whether a physically paid change-discrimination pulse and evidence-gated recall of previously learned non-token causal hypotheses improve stable+rewired structural transfer, without tuning MD30 on observed results

scope.frozen_md30_outcome: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO: known 60 native 0.041667 versus Bayesian 0.752500; fresh 60 native 0.638333 versus Bayesian 0.470833; crossfork delta -0.110000 violates -0.030 motif maximum; original MD30 cohort unused
scope.no_changes_to: Frozen MD29/MD30 source, protocols, original cohort, accepted refs, native Yggdrasil weights, owner/controller/runner, queue, schedulers, main, Wingless, Hybrid, FORGE
scope.standing_authorization: External synthetic research branch, PR and CI only. Not authority to merge/promote, run original scientific first-use, or mutate loop.

scientific_hypothesis.primary: After one paid discriminating internal-node probe at an unannounced phase transition, non-gradient causal evidence can choose whether to reuse stage-0 knowledge or reopen stage-1 memory and improve whole-episode net reward versus the strongest frozen MD30 control, while preserving performance on both genuinely stable and rewired cases
scientific_hypothesis.mechanism: Evidential Change Ledger: preserve frozen MD30 stage0/stage1 hypothesis banks; perform one paid diagnostic selected by disagreement of their predicted sensor outcomes, then compare bank-specific observed causal residuals. Reuse prechange bank unless alternative provides independently observed higher evidence by fixed margin
scientific_hypothesis.null: A frozen adaptive Bayesian causal graph filter, original native tournament or simple always-carry/switch controls perform as well or better; predictions of change do not improve above 50% on balanced cases
scientific_hypothesis.independence: No post-MD30 parameter tuning; this is newly frozen separate mechanism/test; old MD30 source remains byte-identical and unmodified

task.world: Existing StructuralRewire-v1 in MD30, imported read-only from exact parent SHA
task.first_stage_change: Underneath world may remain identical or structurally rewire; phase number is always public but NOT a change flag; all-zero ambient six-bit sensor vector identical in either case
task.task_identifiability_preflight: Synthetic unscored fixture seeds 7301..7312: for each motif compare stable vs rewired matched seed; stage1 ambient observation identical, at least one paid permitted internal clamp yields differing downstream sensor vector. If not, TASK_NO_GO before new candidate scoring.

allocation.shared_training: Existing MD30 paid_training_episodes() 240 synthetic train episodes seeds 3301..3540, exactly 1920 charged World.step receipts; no additional training data
allocation.stable_rewire_allocation: rewire iff seed%2==0; exactly 60 stable, 60 rewired; each motif has 20 of each
allocation.retrospective_cohorts: MD30 earlier 5301..5360 and prior fresh 6301..6360 forbidden from new mechanism selection/scoring; only frozen numeric reference, not reused as MD31 scored data
allocation.hard_guard: Refuse all MD31-scored or first-use episode seeds outside frozen synthetic 8301..8420; never expose seed, rewire boolean or motif to any policy

model.source_hypotheses: build_hypotheses() exactly 768 frozen universal DAG response signatures; same for all arms; no true graph/generator read within policy
model.frozen_training: PersistentCausalMemory.fit unchanged from MD30; three previously qualified controls unchanged
model.mechanism_on_first_stage: Exact untouched CausalTournament persistent stage0 choose/consume with its native 32-hypothesis vote and at most 2 charged diagnostics. After irreversible action, preserve its last stage0 winners and recall original stage1 active winners as alternate bank.
model.stage1_probe: Before stage1 irreversible decision force exactly one physically charged internal-node clamp (node 2/3/4, value 0/1) with largest sum across six sensor positions of absolute difference in mean predicted binary outcomes between 32 stage0 and 32 stage1 hypotheses. Lexicographic tie: smallest node, then 0. All arms in matched-gate group choose the same action and pay 0.05.
model.evidence_rule: For each pool, mean across 32 hypotheses of six-bit score +1 per correct predicted bit and -2 per contradicted bit, using ONLY the paid stage1 probe sensor receipt. Select stage1 bank iff stage1-minus-stage0 mean score >=0.75; else select stage0 bank. No hidden flags, future, true graph or seed. Stage1 base online state updated with same real probe; imported alternate hypotheses receive the same paid evidence exactly once.
model.memory_transition: Switch base.active to selected bank with original global recovery; base._score remains frozen MD30 underlying source. The new ledger changes only active bank selection after charged evidence. No online parameter updates to protected long-term training weights.
model.probe_after_gate: Frozen original CausalTournament may choose at most one additional paid stage1 diagnostic (two total stage1 diagnostics). Capped 2 stage0 and 2 stage1; physical total at most 6.
model.replay: Deterministic JSON audit receipt with source signature SHA, frozen bank hashes and each paid step; cold reloading existing MD30 memory must reproduce byte-identical action/receipt SHA. No learning during evaluation.

controls.fairness: Shared identical trained 768 hypothesis bank and 1920 charged training actions where applicable; each policy executes an independent charged physical world run with same seed/motif and at most eight physical steps. Gate/sham/carry perform the exact same forced paid diagnostic; base/Bayes may choose their own paid diagnostic actions within same cap.
controls.no_lookahead: Internal signature planning permitted; no hidden World clone or uncharged World.step; no reward/rewire label delivered to gate; labels used only after run for audit
controls.strongest_control: Per-seed paired comparison against stronger mean of unchanged Bayesian and original MD30, not a cherry-picked favorable submodel
controls.time_cost: Report policy action count/probes, training and eval CPU seconds, model/checkpoint bytes, deterministic hashes; no CPU/GPU mixed-cost claim
controls.negative: Sham detector consumes same probe but always reopens stage1 bank, always-carry uses same probe but always keeps stage0; a genuine discriminating mechanism must exceed both on frozen evaluation

thresholds.development_only_primary: Across 120 new frozen synthetic episodes, candidate mean net utility at least +0.05 over the stronger of frozen MD30 Bayesian or frozen native original by their mean net reward; precommitted paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 using 2000 paired resamples seed 83131
thresholds.motif_and_regime: Candidate worse by no more than 0.03 mean reward versus the stronger reference in each motif (40 samples), and in each stable/rewire regime (60 samples)
thresholds.change_identification: Among 120 balanced cases, predicted rewiring accuracy >=0.65, with confusion matrix, and accuracy > matched sham always-stage1 baseline (0.50); this is diagnostic only
thresholds.mechanism_ablation: Candidate mean utility > sham and always-carry by at least +0.03; otherwise NO_GO because paid observation did not show useful causal attribution
thresholds.if_task_fail: TASK_NO_GO; no candidate run if identical baseline / paid diagnostic cannot discriminate graphs
thresholds.if_null_or_negative: DEVELOPMENT_NO_NOVEL_GAIN; never change thresholds, rule, cohorts or capacities based on results; preserve full receipts
thresholds.scientific_status: Even full development threshold success is not SCIENTIFIC_PASS, AGI, integration or official MD30/MD31 validation; strongest trained conventional adequacy and independent official first use separately required
